page_title: DOR 3-0 UNI | Dortmund v Union Berlin 31/08/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+3' Andrej Ilic (Union Berlin) climbs high to connect with a cross near the penalty spot but plants a header well wide of the left post.
90+2' Leopold Querfeld (Union Berlin) strikes the ball harmlessly from a long-range free kick and it goes high over the bar. It's not easy to score from a distance like that.
90' 4 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
89' It looks like Karim Adeyemi (Dortmund) saw red with that tackle. Daniel Schlager won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul.
87' Here is a change. Serhou Guirassy is going off and Niko Kovac gives the last tactical orders to Karim Adeyemi (Dortmund).
86' A substitution has been made. Marcel Sabitzer is replaced by Pascal Gross (Dortmund).
86' Aljoscha Kemlein (Union Berlin) whips in the resulting set piece but it's cleared.
85' Julian Ryerson (Dortmund) makes a rough challenge and Daniel Schlager blows his whistle for a foul. Union Berlin will take a free kick near the side line.
84' Union Berlin fail to score from a corner as Gregor Kobel (Dortmund) leaps to collect the ball.
82' Substitution. Janik Haberer did his best and is replaced by Aljoscha Kemlein (Union Berlin).
81' 3 - 0 Goal! Felix Nmecha (Dortmund) picks up the ball from a rebound and from the edge of the box he unleashes a shot inside the right post. It's 3:0.
81' Dortmund force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
80' The attendance is 81365.

79' What a chance that is! Marcel Sabitzer (Dortmund) finds himself unmarked in a promising position after receiving a cross on the edge of the box and his attempt sails a whisker wide of the right post.
77' Niko Kovac has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Carney Chukwuemeka (Dortmund) replacing Maximilian Beier.
76' Today's match ends for Aaron Anselmino who will be replaced by Julian Ryerson (Dortmund).
73' Dortmund are showcasing great team work by exchanging some short passes and one-two passes, waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
71' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Jobe Bellingham walks off the pitch to be replaced by Felix Nmecha (Dortmund).
70' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Derrick Kohn (Union Berlin) comes onto the pitch for Robert Skov.
70' Steffen Baumgart decides to make a substitution. Ilyas Ansah will be replaced by Oliver Burke (Union Berlin).
70' Jobe Bellingham (Dortmund) launches into a thunderous tackle on his opponent and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.

68' Ramy Bensebaini (Dortmund) blew a promising chance when he got to a rebound just outside the penalty area. He struck it towards the bottom right corner, but Frederik Ronnow pulled off a nice save to stop the attempt.
64' Steffen Baumgart has decided to substitute Alex Kral and he is replaced by Woo-Yeong Jeong (Union Berlin).
64' Substitution. Tim Skarke (Union Berlin) has come on for Christopher Trimmel.
63' Christopher Trimmel (Union Berlin) sends in the corner, but fails to find the head of any of his teammates, allowing the defence to clear.
63' An attempted cross from Janik Haberer (Union Berlin) is cleared. The referee signals a corner kick to Union Berlin.
61' Daniel Schlager blows his whistle and signals a foul after Marcel Sabitzer (Dortmund) brought his opponent down.
58' 2 - 0 GOAL - 2:0! Maximilian Beier found Serhou Guirassy (Dortmund) inside the box, he spotted goalkeeper Frederik Ronnow off his line and chipped the ball into the net. What a cheeky lob!
57' Serhou Guirassy (Dortmund) dribbles his way to the edge of the box and drills a shot towards the middle of the goal, but Frederik Ronnow is equal to the effort and makes a good save.
54' Danilho Doekhi (Union Berlin) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
53' Danilho Doekhi (Union Berlin) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
52' The foul by Ilyas Ansah (Union Berlin) was seen by Daniel Schlager who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
48' Gregor Kobel leaps to intercept the corner kick from Christopher Trimmel (Union Berlin).
47' Andrej Ilic (Union Berlin) peeled away from his marker and got on the end of the corner, but his fine header towards the right post is brilliantly saved by the diving goalkeeper.
47' Christopher Trimmel (Union Berlin) steps up to send the ball in.
46' Christopher Trimmel (Union Berlin) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger. The ball is out of play. Union Berlin will have a chance to score from a corner.
46' Referee Daniel Schlager blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+6' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+4' Serhou Guirassy (Dortmund) looks to break free, but his touch lets him down and he loses the ball. The ball goes out of play and Union Berlin will have a goal kick.
45' 5 additional min. will be played.

44' 1 - 0 Yan Couto sends a precise lofted cross into the box. Serhou Guirassy (Dortmund) latches on to it and finishes with a quick shot into the top of the net. The goalkeeper had no chance. The score changes to 1:0.
42' Andrej Ilic (Union Berlin) takes a wild swing at a rebound from mid-range and it goes well wide of the right post.
41' Christopher Trimmel (Union Berlin) puts a cross into the box from the free kick, but the defender gets there first.

40' Ramy Bensebaini (Dortmund) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Daniel Schlager has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle. It's a free kick to Union Berlin in a dangerous position.
37' Yan Couto (Dortmund) lifts the ball into the box from the corner, but one of the defending players gets there first to head it clear.
37' Yan Couto (Dortmund) takes the corner kick but the ball only finds the head of an opponent. Dortmund earn a corner.
37' Yan Couto (Dortmund) connects with a pass but sees his shot from the edge of the box blocked. The linesman points to the corner flag, Dortmund are going to take it.
34' Christopher Trimmel (Union Berlin) takes the corner but only sends it into a huddle of the defenders and one of them makes a good clearance.
33' Janik Haberer (Union Berlin) gets on the end of a pass on the edge of the box but his shot is blocked. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Union Berlin.
32' Yan Couto (Dortmund) goes over to take a corner kick after one of the defenders makes a good clearance.
32' Daniel Svensson (Dortmund) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Dortmund.
29' Ramy Bensebaini (Dortmund) attempts to find one of his teammates, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone. The ball goes out of play and Union Berlin will have a goal kick.
24' Daniel Svensson (Dortmund) is penalised for holding. Daniel Schlager signals a set piece.
23' Serhou Guirassy (Dortmund) gets inside the penalty area and sends a powerful shot that almost ends inside the net. The keeper is alert and makes a good save.
20' Andrej Ilic (Union Berlin) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
20' Jobe Bellingham (Dortmund) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
17' Andrej Ilic (Union Berlin) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
17' Jobe Bellingham (Dortmund) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
16' Serhou Guirassy (Dortmund) shows off his individual ability with a jinking run into the box. Unfortunately, the finish lets him down as the ball flies high over the bar.

15' Daniel Svensson (Dortmund) takes the resultant free kick from the edge of the box and tries to find one of his teammates with a cross, but the keeper climbs high and gets to it first, collecting the ball with ease.
14' Robert Skov (Union Berlin) trips an opponent with a slide tackle. Daniel Schlager stops the game and he could give him a card, but eventually decides on just a warning. Dortmund have a free kick.
9' The corner from Christopher Trimmel (Union Berlin) is intercepted by the defence.
8' Ilyas Ansah (Union Berlin) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted. Good work from Union Berlin as they win a corner.
8' Daniel Schlager blows his whistle and it's Yan Couto (Dortmund) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
6' A precise low pass is received by Rani Khedira (Union Berlin), who makes a yard for himself on the edge of the box, but his poorly placed shot sails well over the bar.
4' A cross is whipped into the centre of the box towards Andrej Ilic (Union Berlin). He gets a good contact on the ball but heads it high over the bar.
3' Julian Brandt (Dortmund) attempts to find one of his teammates, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Union Berlin.
1' The match has just started.
Dortmund will kick the game off.
Daniel Schlager is introduced as the referee for today's match.
